|game_text=Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may take one Informant into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At same and related sites, opponent’s [[Permanent Weapon]] weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). (Immune to Alter.)

|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Undercover (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. Once during your control phase, may ▲ Informant. Whenever opponent fires a permanent weapon at same or related site, subtract 1 from each weapon destiny (2 if targeting this character). [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may take one Informant into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At same and related sites, opponent’s [[Permanent Weapon]] weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Once during” → “During”; “▲ Informant. Whenever opponent fires a permanent weapon at” → “take one Informant into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At”; “or” → “and”; “site, subtract 1 from each” → “sites, opponent’s Permanent Weapon”; “(2” → “draws are -1 (-2”; “[Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 50. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Undercover (Dark)]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Undercover (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Undercover (Dark)]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_50.
